headline: Cal State Monterey Bay fall, Cal State LA stay perfect
dek: Cal State Monterey Bay's unbeaten start ended on the road at Point Loma, leaving Cal State LA as the only side in the conference still winning every match. They won at Westmont the same day, a fifth win in five, and have yet to concede a goal.

pattern.label: derived
pattern.text: Fresno Pacific's 24 goals are more than Stanislaus State and Cal State San Bernardino have scored together, and nine different players have shared them.

wire.line: Cal State East Bay have conceded twenty-three goals and are the only side in the conference still without a win.

findings.label: observed
findings.text: Ten matches have passed their date with no result recorded; the latest is Cal State Dominguez Hills' match with Concordia Irvine, and every other one was in August.

findings.label: observed
findings.text: Menlo's draw with Hawaii Pacific was their first of the season, and leaves them with two wins, two defeats, eight goals scored and eight conceded.

findings.label: derived
findings.text: Cal State San Bernardino have won four and drawn two after beating Texas A&M International, and have conceded two goals across them.

findings.label: observed
findings.text: UC Merced have won one and drawn three, and have yet to lose.

findings.label: observed
findings.text: Zion Vaughn has scored seven goals from fifteen shots for Fresno Pacific.

last_match.line: Menlo had never drawn a match this season before it; Hawaii Pacific have now drawn at Stanislaus State and Menlo and lost at Chico State on the same California trip.

next_match.line: Conference play opens with Cal Poly Humboldt yet to win since August; Menlo are unbeaten since their defeat by Northwest Nazarene.

validation.policy: observed and derived claims are recomputed against the data home before publish; failures are dropped, not softened. signal and projected pass on schema unless the data contradicts a figure. context is never validated as a finding.
